//: Requirement ids held for unlanded branches, so that two branches never
write the same new id. A branch reserves its range here in a docs-only
landing under the lock before it writes the ids, and releases it --
deletes or shrinks its entry -- in the commit that writes them, so the
release lands with the ids. tools/common/check/check-traceability.py
refuses a new id that main's copy of this file did not hold at the
branch's merge-base, and a range that overlaps another or holds an id
the model defines. `ids` takes single ids and ranges, L.object.106-112.
docs/CONVENTIONS.md, 'Requirement ids are reserved before they are written'.
